artifacts.summary: 6-phase implementation plan for LK/LJ sequent calculi with cut elimination and equivalence bridges

memory_candidates.content: For sequent calculus formalizations in Lean 4, the all-additive Finset-based presentation (shared contexts, no splitting) eliminates exchange and contraction as definitional equalities, requiring only explicit weakening constructors. This dramatically simplifies cut elimination proofs compared to multiplicative presentations. When bridging to existing natural deduction systems that also use Finset contexts, the structural translations become near-definitional. Composing bridge proofs via an intermediate system (e.g., hilbert_iff_lk := hilbert_iff_nd.trans nd_iff_lk) avoids duplicating deduction theorem machinery (~400 lines savings). Cut elimination termination uses lexicographic induction on (formula_complexity, left_height + right_height) with Proposition.complexity as the cut-rank measure.
